notes: Configured recognizer retained. Recognition does not establish executable support; the current boundary is one standalone App with core Print and Text.
References preserve canonical declaration/member identity. A reference must resolve in its owning scope. The value category independently determines permitted use.
Recognizes a Text token. Ordinary source Text and typed scalar/native-byte emission are implemented. Preserve literal bytes and distinguish framing escapes from general string escapes.
Recognizes a binary64 Number token, not a %-delimited source literal. Range, finite-value and native encoding boundaries remain stage-specific.
Recognizes a Truth token loaded from lowercase true/false. This pattern does not introduce ?-delimited source literals or implicit truthiness.
Explicit Null initializes an absence value. Show renders null. It is distinct from an unassigned slot and internal None/Unknown states.
Matches the native type token category. Construction and usable values depend on the explicit source type whitelist, descriptor binding and selected category.

Typed owned Lists construct, append, replace and read indexed values. Heterogeneous construction infers Thing without coercion. Indices and complete element types are checked. Iteration/removal remain outside this API.
Recognizes Dictionary type/storage structure. Namespace members and imports are demonstrated. Arbitrary runtime map operations are not thereby supported.
A quoted declaration plus typed declarative phrase. Native whitelist and construction rules determine the represented category.
A named List requires an explicit runtime constructor for initialization. Typed elements and checked operations follow the List contract.
A quoted Dictionary declaration provides owned namespace/storage. Generic runtime map operations remain outside the established surface.
A quoted name and definitive declarative phrase participate in typed registration/construction.
A quoted name with a definitional Text phrase must satisfy paired framing and typed definition parsing.
A quoted name and value phrase retain the concrete value category and assignment/definite-assignment boundaries.
A quoted name may carry an optional phrase. Registration ownership and context determine whether that site is a usable declaration.
A resolved identifier preserves its selected owner and canonical declaration. It is not a fresh declaration.
A #~# type token selects a native category rather than a quoted source identifier. Its supported role depends on the enclosing grammar.
A resolved definition and generic phrase preserve source ownership, bound parameters and permitted composition.
A quoted action label followed by a for/directive body records ordered source actions and typed any-parameters.
A quoted label with a to/utilization phrase defines native text or a supported action relation. It is not an import provider phrase.
An encapsulated paragraph begins with the ordinary Function declaration and owns its body. Public visibility exposes the Function, not its parameters.
A quoted parameter name is paired with a complete runtime type or an existing callable signature.
A Text name precedes a resolved nominal definition and optional relations. Naming alone does not establish a constructor for every internal value tag.
A Text name precedes a recognized native type and optional relations. The explicit native type and descriptor contracts determine supported construction.
A quoted identifier occurs as an owned declaration/reference role. It is not a Text literal or a universal executable scalar value.
A named reference carries a dependency phrase. Supported Use import scanning and source-provider ownership remain authoritative. Arbitrary grammar placement does not imply import execution.
An atomic operand leaves its destination phrase for the enclosing update clause. Its resolved runtime type still governs use.

A checked callable construction can carry explicit constructor operands before its signature, or a structured Process input signature and directive body. Canonical targets determine the native constructor and scoped binding roles.

The for phrase contains ordered applicative clauses. Source actions retain their generic argument and recursion checks. Structured Process inputs and locals bind within that body while retaining enclosing Function references. This adds no general loop syntax.
Recognizes List construction arguments. The List contract defines typed elements, checked updates, indexed reads and bounds errors. This recognizer adds no general source loop syntax.
The phrase owns a declaration object whose scope and publication are resolved semantically.
The as phrase supplies a bound value. Concrete type and runtime assignment requirements remain enforced.
The body is a typed Text object with explicit framing/escaping at the definition boundary.
A declarative alias phrase must resolve its target and preserve canonical ownership. It does not copy an application or widen visibility.
Declares an ordinary Function with its signature.
Pairs a named parameter with a complete runtime type or existing Function signature.
Configured in/collection relation. The retained grammar does not establish general executable insertion, indexing, or dictionary mutation.
Consumes the destination and its complete Number/Text key phrase. An at keyword without a key is not an update.
The to phrase contains an imperative clause. Enclosing definition semantics determine how it is used, distinct from dependency imports.
The to phrase contains a Text object. Native definition framing and typed argument encoding, not an import path, determine its meaning.
A Function declaration defines an ordinary invocation verb. Its sentence binds ordered typed arguments and explicit result names. Member ownership selects the declaration.
The source-defined action signature and canonical binding determine the subject/object arguments and their order. Native definition slot kinds are a separate interface.
Create a typed ordinary Function at an encapsulated paragraph boundary. Each declaration activation owns its capture environment.
A bare condition requires one Truth operand. Optional negation belongs to this condition, with no scalar truthiness or joined-condition contract.
Has is bounded to the selected App Error member and must retain matching target ownership.
The exact configured phrase maps to a typed scalar operator. Equality requires matching scalar types. Order requires Number. Native operator witnesses do not independently verify every source phrase.

Input-only Process signatures bind pattern or iteration values within their directive body. Provisional labels cannot shadow enclosing inputs before their owner is resolved. Native selection/pair, mixed-nesting and scope-escape/output rejection witnesses constrain support. No general closure or Process output signature is added.
Configured spelling and grammatical handlers are retained. The linked entry describes the core-only reset boundary; this inventory does not assert runtime execution.

Configured native representation spelling, not a public application constructor or alias for the source Function, Property or Operation category. Its configuration handler is not executable API evidence.
Build one standalone App directly from its source bundle. Accepts one optional source, defaulting to main.l. Runtime orchestration is rejected.
Complete replacement filesystem. FlagSet also accepts single-hyphen and equals-value spellings.
Publish executable and companion output together, relative to the caller CWD.
Select source lexicon. The bundled default is eng. Explicit empty values fail.
Standalone --version/-v prints the embedded version and newline without compiler initialization.
Sole top-level help or command help before the source filename.
Supported help alias.
End flag parsing, including before a filename beginning with a dash.
The -os option is currently rejected.

Version 2 evidence records selected compilation inputs, tool observations, the actual Cargo invocation, artifact digests and companion generation. Evidence is written before executable publication. Failed Cargo invocations and later publication failures remain distinguishable; the App is not run and native behavior is not certified.
Current reset: configured or source-declared meaning only; executable support is limited to one standalone App with core Print and Text.

CV constructs one unscheduled future. Local Capture selects Infer or Move. DV awaits one native or composed operand in async context. CO/COB bind one value. Rust enforces ownership and typing. This adds no async-FW modifier or Function dispatcher.
description: Static coverage and existing witnesses; no language execution during website validation.
